answer: Make earnings grow with an unbroken work thread. Each identity's answers form a hash-linked chain, and its payout is 10 percent of a full share in its first epoch, rising 10 points per epoch to 100 percent at epoch 10. Missing an epoch or failing a grade resets the thread to zero. A farm that spins up 500 fresh heads earns only 50 shares at first and must keep all 500 producing distinct passing work for 10 epochs. Like saffron or a rare pigment, standing is costly because it is slow to make.
